violations.description: Hardcoded AWS secret access key in workflow environment block
violations.evidence: AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY hardcoded string in workflow env block
violations.recommendation: Remove hardcoded credentials from workflow files and use GitHub Actions encrypted secrets instead.

violations.description: Hardcoded database password in workflow environment block
violations.evidence: DATABASE_PASSWORD: [REDACTED] hardcoded in workflow env block
violations.recommendation: Remove hardcoded credentials from workflow files and use GitHub Actions encrypted secrets instead.

violations.description: Hardcoded PyPI API token in workflow environment block
violations.evidence: PYPI_API_TOKEN hardcoded string in workflow env block
violations.recommendation: Remove hardcoded credentials from workflow files and use GitHub Actions encrypted secrets instead.

violations.description: Hardcoded Docker Hub token in workflow environment block
violations.evidence: DOCKER_HUB_TOKEN hardcoded string in workflow env block
violations.recommendation: Remove hardcoded credentials from workflow files and use GitHub Actions encrypted secrets instead.

violations.description: Uploading sensitive SSH keys and private key files as workflow artifacts
violations.recommendation: Do not upload private keys, SSH keys, or local environment files as CI artifacts.

violations.description: Echoing or printing secrets to CI build logs
violations.evidence: echo "GitHub Token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" and printenv | grep -i token in workflow steps
violations.recommendation: Do not print sensitive tokens, keys, or environment variables to CI logs.

violations.evidence: npm publish --token=${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }} passes token via CLI argument
violations.recommendation: Pass authentication tokens via environment variables or configuration files rather than command-line arguments.

violations.description: Uploading sensitive configuration and credential files as workflow artifacts
violations.recommendation: Do not upload sensitive files, environment files, or credentials as CI artifacts.

violations.description: Using bash debug mode (set -x) with sensitive environment variables
violations.evidence: set -x enabled in a step that references AWS credentials
violations.recommendation: Avoid enabling set -x or bash tracing in steps that handle sensitive variables or credentials.

violations.description: Verbose HTTP requests logging authorization headers containing secrets
violations.evidence: curl -v with Authorization: [REDACTED] header in workflow step
violations.recommendation: Do not use verbose curl or HTTP request logging when sending authorization headers or secrets.
